teaser: Every article now has a Pen to mark it, comment and tell the newsroom, and a browser key pki.sgit.ai vouches for signs each note as mine.
core_idea: Feedback on a page should happen on the page: the Pen keeps a selection the moment it is made, out of the iPad's own menu, holds private marks with comments and notes for the newsroom with their passages, and signs those notes with a key for this browser that my key on pki.sgit.ai operates, so anyone can check them against the public register from a pinned root; of four ways to log in with that key, the key per browser works now, the sign-in redirect is the end state, and the two vaults stay separate, connected by keys.

nodes.label: Feedback through a chat
nodes.summary: What I tell the newsroom about a page goes into a chat window, away from the page.

nodes.label: The iPad's menu in the way
nodes.summary: Copy, Look Up and Translate sit above a selection, where the Highlight button was.

nodes.label: A bar at the foot
nodes.summary: Keep, Comment, Tell the newsroom, out of the menu's way; the selection kept as it is made.

nodes.label: A Pen on every article
nodes.summary: A panel on the right: selected, my marks, tell the newsroom, signed as you.

nodes.label: Private marks with comments
nodes.summary: Highlights with a comment of my own, kept in the browser, never sent.

nodes.label: Notes with their passages
nodes.summary: The vault pane's own notes, sent down my lane when I press Send.

nodes.label: The register's operates rule
nodes.summary: One key vouches for another both ways, with an end date.

nodes.label: A key per browser
nodes.summary: Made with pki.sgit.ai's code; operated by my key; signs every note.

nodes.label: Checked from a pinned root
nodes.summary: In the browser and in Python, from my key's fingerprint, never the register's own anchors.

nodes.label: Four ways to log in
nodes.summary: One passkey, a sign-in redirect, a key per browser, the same by QR code.

nodes.label: Key per browser now, redirect later
nodes.summary: Works with pki.sgit.ai as it is; the redirect is the end state; not one passkey.

nodes.label: Two vaults, connected by keys
nodes.summary: The reader vault and the pki.sgit.ai account stay separate.

nodes.label: What is left
nodes.summary: My first link, an authorize page, the key in the vault, the newsroom's own lane.

quotes.text: It was not a bug in either; they simply wanted the same place.
quotes.why: The iPad problem stated without blame, and why the fix is to move.

quotes.text: It is a place of my own because the key is mine.
quotes.why: What a login means here: a key, not an account on a server.
